description: Angular SDK to view PDFs, place visual signatures and add digital signatures through your backend.
rules: Placements are stored normalized (0..1, origin top-left of the visual page), independent of zoom and rotation.
exportPdf() needs withPdfLibWriter(); exportCoordinates() and (coordinatesChange) need no writer.
The library never performs cryptography: digital signatures are made by your backend through SigningWorkflow.
The PDF.js worker must be served by the app at the workerSrc URL.
